title: Reinhard Gehlen, Knight of Malta, put in charge of West German intelligence by the OSS
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Reinhard Gehlen, Knight of Malta, put in charge of West German intelligence by the OSS, about end of World War II at West Germany, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Reinhard Galen is the guy that was the head of the antis-siet and anti- Eastern black intelligence for the Third Reich

plain: Dan Sheehan, a guest on a podcast about UFOs and President John F. Kennedy, talks about Reinhard Gehlen, who he says ran anti-Soviet and Eastern European intelligence for Nazi Germany. Sheehan says that at the end of World War II the OSS, America's wartime spy agency, put Gehlen in charge of West German intelligence, and that Gehlen was a Knight of Malta, a member of an old Catholic order; he cites a man named Shackley. He tells it to show how wartime spy networks fed into the secret world he connects to UFO secrecy.
